verdict.rationale: No CLI is documented, so the headless 'via the CLI' part is unmet. An agent can still reach the same outcome through other documented paths. The v1 API (backed by a published OpenAPI spec and CI/CD-named API keys) triggers scans and returns machine-readable vulnerability data, and the official MCP server lets an AI tool pull findings, triage them, and file tickets in Jira, Linear, ClickUp, or Shortcut. Missing for 10: an official headless CLI, documented machine-readable output formats such as SARIF or JSON from a local run, and hands-on corroboration of an agent-driven scan-to-ticket loop (community reports of confident false positives also make 'real findings' filtering uncertain).
